## Loading the packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(readxl)
```

## Loading the boundaries data

Here I load the New Zealand territorial authority boundaries.

```{r}
nz_shape <- st_read("prac1_data/nz_data/statsnz-territorial-authority-2018-generalised-SHP/territorial-authority-2018-generalised.shp")
```
## Loading the census table

Here I load the 2018 census table.

```{r}
path <- "prac1_data/nz_data/Statistical-Area-1-dataset-for-Census-2018-total-New_Zealand_updated_4-11-21/2018-SA1-dataset-individual-part-3a-total-NZ_updated_16-7-20.xlsx"

raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = "Territorial authority", col_names = FALSE)
```

## Building

```{r}
hdr <- tibble(year = unlist(raw[9, ]), measure = unlist(raw[10, ])) %>% fill(year)
nz_data <- raw[-(1:10), ]
names(nz_data) <- paste(hdr$year, hdr$measure, sep = "_")
names(nz_data)[1:2] <- c("ta_code", "ta_name")
```

## Building 2


```{r}
col2018 <- names(nz_data)[startsWith(names(nz_data), "2018") &
                          endsWith(names(nz_data), "_Paid employee")]
```

## Identifying relevant data

```{r}
nz_employees <- nz_data %>%
  filter(ta_code != "Total") %>%
  select(ta_code, paid_employee_2018 = all_of(col2018)) %>%
  mutate(paid_employee_2018 = as.numeric(paid_employee_2018))
```

## Joining and mapping

I join the paid employee counts to the boundaries using the territorial authority code.

```{r}
nz_map <- nz_shape %>%
  left_join(., nz_employees, by = c("TA2018_V1_" = "ta_code"))
nrow(nz_map)
sum(is.na(nz_map$paid_employee_2018))
```

## Reprojecting to New Zealand's own coordinate system

New Zealand's Chatham Islands lie across the 180° line, which stretches a latitude/longitude map across the globe and shrinks the mainland. I reproject to NZTM 2000 (EPSG:2193), New Zealand's own coordinate system, so the map fills the frame.

```{r}
nz_map_nztm <- nz_map %>% st_transform(., 2193)
```

## Map of paid employees

````{r}
tm_shape(nz_map_nztm) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "paid_employee_2018",
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Paid employees, 2018")) +
  tm_title("Paid employees by territorial authority, New Zealand, 2018")
````
